W1.fault: sample ratio mismatch: 50,912 against 49,088 has a chi-square p-value far below 0.001; the result cannot be trusted until the cause is found and the test is rerun

W2.fault: peeking: a stop on the first daily p below 0.05 is not the pre-registered test; the day-28 analysis planned in the pre-registration shows no effect

W3.fault: novelty decay: the lift falls from 7.1% in week 1 to 0.2% in week 4; the settled effect is not shown to be above zero, so run longer before deciding

W4.fault: clean: trustworthy assignment, pre-registered analysis, guardrails held

W5.fault: harm guardrail: courier earnings fell beyond the pre-registered threshold; the board stops a test whose harm guardrail worsens
